entities.summary: Admiral Henrique Eduardo Passaláqua de Gouveia e Melo is a retired Portuguese Navy officer. He mostly recently served as the Chief of the Naval Staff, from 2021 to 2024, and ran for President in the 2026 Portuguese presidential election as an independent.
